title: Map descent for a bounded graded family without relations
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $Q^n$ be $A$-modules for $n\in\mathbf Z$ and $\delta^{mn}:Q^m\to Q^n$ maps which vanish unless $m+1=n$. Fix $i\in I$, finitely presented $F(i)$-modules $M^n$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], integers $a,b$ such that $M^n$ is zero for $n<a$ or $b<n$, and isomorphisms $e_n:M^n\otimes_{F(i)}A\cong Q^n$. There exist $j\ge i$, maps $d^{mn}:M^m\otimes_{F(i)}F(j)\to M^n\otimes_{F(i)}F(j)$ vanishing unless $m+1=n$, and isomorphisms $e'_n:(M^n\otimes_{F(i)}F(j))\otimes_{F(j)}A\cong Q^n$ satisfying $e'_n\circ(d^{mn}\otimes A)=\delta^{mn}\circ e'_m$. Neither the input nor output maps are required to have zero successive composites.

proof.text: Equip M(n) and M(n+1) with zero differentials, yielding cochain complexes C and B. Conjugate delta(n,n+1) by e(n) and e(n+1) to produce arbitrary graded components between their colimit extensions. Both term families are finitely presented and C has the given bounded support.

Apply bounded graded component-map descent to C and B with these components. It yields a common stage and descended components with canonical scalar-extension comparisons, without imposing chain-map or square-zero equations.

Identify the components of the complex comparison with the module scalar-extension comparison. Set e prime to its inverse followed by e and define d(m,n) by the descended component if m+1=n, zero otherwise. Cancellation proves the adjacent squares; the shape hypothesis gives the remaining squares. This includes empty support and preorder indices without a separate reduction.

theorem exists_bounded_graded_maps_of_directed_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F]
    (Q : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}))
    (δ : ∀ m n : ℤ, Q m ⟶ Q n)
    (hδ : ∀ m n : ℤ, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel m n → δ m n = 0)
    (i : I) (M : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i)) (a b : ℤ)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (M n))
    (hfp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) (M n))
    (e : ∀ n : ℤ, (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj (M n) ≅ Q n) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      let G := extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom
      let E := extendScalars (colimit.ι F j).hom
      ∃ (d : ∀ m n : ℤ, G.obj (M m) ⟶ G.obj (M n))
        (e' : ∀ n : ℤ, E.obj (G.obj (M n)) ≅ Q n),
        (∀ m n : ℤ, ¬ (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel m n → d m n = 0) ∧
        (∀ m n : ℤ, (e' m).hom ≫ δ m n = E.map (d m n) ≫ (e' n).hom)
